boards.hardware: ESP32-S31NRV16, ES8389, Waveshare 3.6-inch e-Paper (E), BQ27220, PCF85063, SC7A20
boards.identify: paper V2 board; 3.6-inch 400x600 six-color display on U1 (50 pins), H1 BS0 grounded
boards.flash_port: Type-C USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO33/34; hold BOOT (GPIO61) while connecting for download mode
boards.use: WiFi desktop: bilingual app menu, daily alarm, calendar, SD WAV music, HTTP LLM messages/history with local JSON tools, and PCM16 realtime voice
boards.notes: Product ID 8, chip_type esp32-s31. ESP-IDF 6.1. Build/host verification only; hardware and live platform acceptance pending. PCM16 voice; no Opus library for S31. Chinese/English UI. MQTT disabled; BLE discovery toggle; phone hotspot WiFi setup.
